one_line: A contrarian "stop" hook, one tip card every few seconds, then a comment word that delivers a free file.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 chest-up, she faces the lens holding a board book low, speaks (transcript): "אל תקריאו כל מילה בסיפור". A white box mid-frame: "תפסיקו להקריא לילד שלכם כל מילה בסיפור". Fixed top label "מקלינאית תקשורת התפתחותית".
q1_hook.why: A "stop" command against what parents think is right, spoken to the lens from 0:00 (H1, H4), said and shown at once (H6, T3). It names the viewer's own habit, a parent who reads every word (K6). The better method is promised, not yet shown, so the value lands only around 0:03 to 0:06 (H2).

beats.what: Facing the lens, book held low; "תפסיקו להקריא לילד שלכם כל מילה בסיפור"
beats.why: A command and a credential label in one frame.

beats.what: She taps the cover; "התייחסו גם לכריכה של הסיפור"
Opens to a page with a tricycle; "הפיקו פעלים: לאכול, רוכבת"
beats.why: The tip is performed, not explained.

beats.what: Points at the picture; "הצביעו ותארו את התמונות"
beats.why: A new card and a new gesture.

beats.what: Hand to mouth, miming a blow; "הוסיפו ג'סטות ופעולות פיזיות"
beats.why: The comic beat; the physical joke breaks the talking-head rhythm.

beats.what: Points into the lens; "שלבו את העולם של הילד בסיפור"
New page, a man with a pot; "הפיקו תארים: קטן, חם"
beats.why: Adjective tip on a second page.

beats.what: She holds the page up, smiling; "תמחישו ותעודדו את הילד להשתתף"
She blows at the lens, sparkles; "כתבו ספרים ותקבלו קובץ ספרים מומלצים", then "עקבו אחרי לעוד תכנים כאלה!"
beats.why: The blow turns the demo into a reveal of the offer.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen from 0:25 and in the caption: comment "ספרים" for a free file. The caption also asks to send it to two kinds of parent, and to follow.
q2_flow.why: A new heading every 2 to 5 s with a gesture each time keeps a text-only list moving (R3, E2), and the tips come inside an energetic performance, not a dry list (K4). The offer at the end is the payoff the opening "stop" implies (R4). The send prompt names two real recipients (R5, C4).

q3_cta.what: On screen from 0:25: "כתבו ספרים ותקבלו קובץ ספרים מומלצים + טיפים לקריאה", then "עקבו אחרי לעוד תכנים כאלה!" (0:27). Not said aloud in the transcript. Caption: comment "ספרים" for the full file, send to two kinds of parent, follow.
q3_cta.why: A comment word that delivers something real, a free age-based book list and tips (C3, R6), shown after the value (C6). But follow and send are stacked on top (C1), the text sits in the bottom 35% (F2), and the caption's first line is general, the word comes later.

q4_shown.what: A woman chest-up holds a Hebrew board book from 0:00 and opens it twice (a child on a tricycle; an older man with a pot), points, mimes a blow, points at the lens. A credential label stays on top. No child, price or result.
q4_shown.why: Each tip is performed on the book in front of the viewer, so it can be checked by eye (S1). The credential label answers "why listen"; no principle on the list covers credentials. The book is an untitled prop, so as product content it is invisible (C7). No child on screen (S5).

q5_edit.what: 5 shots in 29.5 s, 5.9 s average: four jump cuts (1.7, 8.2, 15.2, 25.0 s) on a locked-off phone. Tip headings swap every 2 to 5 s inside the shots. Sparkle effect at 0:25. Ends on her smile.
q5_edit.why: Jump cuts inside one scene at a moderate pace remove pauses without scene changes (E2). Heading swaps carry the pace between cuts (R3). Short key phrases, not a transcript, sit with the voice (E4, T2). It ends right after the CTA with no dead tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: Seven interactive read-aloud tips from a speech-language pathologist, framed as "stop reading every word"; a free age-based book list is offered. Serves parents who want reading to work.
q6_topic.why: Being told you may be reading wrongly touches a real concern, and the answer is a short, doable list (K6, K4). A free book list by age is something to ask for and to forward to another parent (R5, C4). No gift or occasion, so no buying moment (K7).

q7_filmed.what: Locked-off medium shot, chest up, eye level, in a bright living room with a window behind her, phone on a stand. A small clip-on mic with a grey windscreen is visible. She talks to the lens, book held low then raised. No child.
q7_filmed.why: Eye level, direct to the lens and one steady frame is a native creator look (F6, H8, F7). Her face is evenly lit and the frame is full 9:16 (F1). The book is held low and sometimes behind the hook box, and its title is never readable (F4).

q8_text.on_screen: Fixed top label "מקלינאית תקשורת התפתחותית" all Reel, about 16 to 20% down. Hook in a white box at 52 to 63%: "תפסיקו" / "להקריא לילד שלכם כל מילה בסיפור". Then one purple-outlined white heading per tip at about 77%: "הפיקו פעלים" (0:03), "הצביעו ותארו את התמונות" (0:07), "הוסיפו ג'סטות ופעולות פיזיות" (0:10), "שלבו את העולם של הילד בסיפור" (0:15), "תמחישו ותעודדו את הילד להשתתף" (0:23). CTA from 0:25.
q8_text.caption: "קריאת סיפורים זאת הזדמנות מדהימה לזמן משותף,". About 145 words: why reading matters, what she sees parents do, her advice, the comment-word offer, a send prompt, a repetition tip, her intro and a follow ask. No hashtags, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: The hook box and tip headings are short key phrases that read on a phone (T2, T5), and the label gives authority from frame one (T3). Headings and CTA sit at about 77 to 88% down, in the bottom 35% (T4, F2). The caption opens generally, the comment word is below "more" (T7, C6).

weak_points: Seven tips on text alone with headings in the bottom band; follow and send stacked on the comment word; the CTA is not said aloud; the book's title never shows; the caption opens generally and has no hashtags.
lumebook_takeaway: Phone locked-off at eye level, book in hand, contrarian opener, one text card per tip, a comment word that delivers a real file; use facts Yarin owns, not clinical advice.
not_verified: The spoken words of tips 2 to 7 (the transcript is poor, words like "טירס" and "בום בום בום" are reading sounds); the book's title and publisher; whether the file is delivered; the music (none evident); that she is a speech-language pathologist (label and caption only). Corrections to the first pass and breakdowns.md: the hook box covers the book and her torso, not her face; cuts do not fall on every tip, headings swap inside shots; no CTA appears in the transcript. Plays 113,036, likes 1,329 and comments 1,055 on 15 Oct are context only.
